status: Research/design only. No game code or device tests performed.
confirmed_choice: Borrowed shared items return automatically after being unused for a while; personal decorations and saved creations are protected.
proposed_rules: Use item categories; avoid blanket room/world resets.
Keep shared fixtures and essential working kits in their allowed areas; player travel remains free.
Bound shared loans and count items inside containers; personal toy catalog is separate.
Return only eligible unused items, with final authority revalidation and idempotent operation IDs.
Store creations and personal toys as recoverable records; never silently delete them to satisfy clutter budgets.
Preserve a shared prop's canonical identity across moves, returns, host recovery, and offline reconciliation.

unconfirmed_tuning_values.note: Design experiments only, not measured capacity or user-approved numeric settings. Weight complex objects and tune with both children on A10.

sources.title: Toca Boca reset/rebuild guidance
sources.finding: Reset/rebuild can clear progress or house/furniture; broad reset is unsuitable for our everyday cleanup.

sources.title: Toca Boca Lost & Found
sources.finding: Illustrated recovery with filters and rules for trashed gifts/containers; does not document an idle-return timer.

sources.title: Toca Boca gifts and container recovery
sources.finding: Distinguishes already-placed gifts from retrievable stock and contents remaining in a recovered box.

sources.title: Toca Boca bunched-items stability note
sources.finding: Acknowledges unwanted furniture bunching during stability recovery; use as a design caution, not evidence for an internal algorithm.

sources.title: Unity ScriptableObjects
sources.finding: Definition assets for authored item policies; runtime records/save data remain separate in our design.

sources.title: Unity NetworkObject ownership
sources.finding: Server ownership and authority; item-return arbitration remains custom application logic.

sources.title: Unity ObjectPool
sources.finding: Reuses instances; an empty pool can create another, so retained pool capacity is not a gameplay live-item limit.
